sentences.caption: Indians reported losing nearly ₹20,000 crore to cyber fraud in 2025.
Scam Shield checks what you were just sent, before you act.
Paste a message, or add a screenshot, a QR code, a link or a voice note.
English, Hindi and Hinglish are understood.
First, a fake KYC message with a look-alike bank link. One tap runs a real check.
Gemini reads the message.
The verdict is Scam, with a risk score and the type of scam.
Every warning sign quotes the exact words that give it away.
The number and the link are already on the shared scam list: in this demo, three reports each.
The link was opened in an isolated browser, so you see the fake bank form without opening it yourself.
Now a QR code that says you will receive ₹5,000.
Scam Shield decodes it on the server, as part of the same check.
The card shows what it really is: a payment request, to this UPI ID. You never scan a code to receive money.
Next, a voice note: a synthetic fake CBI officer, in Hinglish. Gemini writes down what was said.
The verdict is Scam, a digital arrest threat.
It spots the arrest threat and the fee demand, and says to hang up.
Even a payment screenshot. A buyer says they have paid, and wants you to ship the item. Gemini reads the image to check.
The date is 31 September, which does not exist.
The transaction reference has the wrong length, and the sender name does not match the UPI ID.
Then you can act.
To report it: sign in with Google, then add the scammer's number to the shared list.
Draft the complaint for 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, with the amount lost.
And share a warning card with family. This is the card the app made.
It fits a phone screen too. One tap runs the check, and Report, Complaint and Share sit in a bar at the bottom.
It works in Hindi too. One tap switches the whole app.
The check runs in Hindi, and the verdict comes back in Hindi.
The Trends page shows reports by scam type and state, with demo data while the app is new.
Firebase Hosting serves the app and forwards API calls to a Cloud Run service.
It checks the Firestore scam list, sends any link to a separate, isolated scanner, and asks Gemini on Vertex AI for a structured verdict.
Firebase handles sign-in and file storage.
On 185 synthetic test cases: flagged all 90 scams, wrongly flagged 3.3% of 90 genuine messages.
It is a small test, not a guarantee.
Scam Shield. Check before you click, pay or scan.
